description: Discover our charming apartment in the heart of Paris, ideal for groups of up to 6 people. Enjoy four comfortable beds for peaceful nights. Located in the vibrant 2nd arrondissement, you will be close to department stores, the Opéra Garnier and many other attractions. An elegant retreat for your unforgettable stay in Paris.

enrichment.summary: Listing metadata says 5 beds and 3 bedrooms, while the description says 4 beds and up to 6 guests. Photos show at least one double and two singles, plus two WCs and one distinct shower. A fitted kitchen and dining table are shown; the listing says there is no oven.

issues: Listing metadata and prose conflict on capacity (8 versus up to 6) and bed count (5 versus 4).
Photos show at least one double and two separate singles; no supplied image verifies a third bedroom or further beds.
One distinct shower is visible in bathroom 2; repeated views of that same bathroom are not counted as extra showers. Exterior photos do not show the property entrance or access route.

deepReview.note: Bedroom images show a double bed and two separate singles. Bathroom photos distinguish two rooms, each with a WC, while a shower is visible only in one distinct room. The fitted kitchen has a washer; exterior views do not show the entry route.
